description: Single-scenario Discord coding validation for a document issuance and release-history management system.

scenarios.message: /coder: Build a document issuance management system that starts from Discord intake. The system should let us create different documents from specific Excel templates, assign a unique document number to each one, support one-click document generation, and record full release history. The system should also be designed so it can later expand into complaint tracking and ticket claiming workflows. Please deliver a minimal but usable system with clear assumptions and extension points.
